ProductionCsv.size: Choose a CSV file of at most 2 MB.
ProductionCsv.header: The file needs the columns starts_at, ends_at, energy_kwh or energy_mwh, quality and source; a timezone column may be added.
ProductionCsv.parse: The file could not be read as CSV. Check its commas and quotation marks.
ProductionCsv.count: Use a file with 1 to 2,000 rows.
ProductionCsv.interval: Row {row}: write the start and end with their offset, 30 or 60 minutes apart, as in the example.
ProductionCsv.future: Row {row}: the end lies in the future. Remove the row or correct its time.
ProductionCsv.energy: Row {row}: write the energy as zero or a positive number.
ProductionCsv.quality: Row {row}: write valid, outage, curtailed or invalid in quality, and a source of up to 200 characters.
ProductionCsv.mixed: Row {row}: the half hours of this hour have different statuses. Correct each half hour separately.
ProductionCsv.overlap: Some times in the file overlap. Remove the overlapping rows.
